components.name: DGX Vera Rubin NVL72 rack
components.description: A rack-scale system whose GPUs are connected by NVLink through the NVLink passive copper cable cartridge backplane. It holds compute trays, NVLink switch trays, top-of-rack management switches, power shelves, a bus bar and liquid cooling manifolds.
components.function: Forms a single 72-GPU NVLink domain. NVLink is the scale-up fabric inside the rack, InfiniBand the scale-out fabric between racks, and Ethernet carries storage, management and external traffic.

components.name: Compute tray
components.description: An enclosure that holds the compute boards and peripheral accessory boards and runs an OS image. A tray has two compute boards.
components.function: A compute node with 2 Vera CPUs and 4 Rubin GPUs that runs an OS image. Its GPUs reach the GPUs in the other trays over NVLink through connectors at the back of the tray and the NVLink switch trays.
